name: Cast iron radiator
notes: Floor standing on two cast legs, 13 sections at 58 mm pitch. Supply valve and floor pipe at the left end, bleed key at the top right.
parts: 13 cast-iron column sections, three tubes each
top and bottom header collars with joint rings
brass angle valve with handwheel and floor pipe
bleed valve plug at the top right

style: Old white enamel radiator, chipped paint at the legs and header edges.
summary: Cast-iron column radiator: 13 three-column sections with header collars, end legs, brass supply valve with floor pipe and a bleed plug.
